newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rhone targets more EPS growth, lower gearing in 97.
newsitem.headline: Rhone targets more EPS growth, lower gearing in 97.

text.p: Rhone-Poulenc, reporting a 25.8 percent rise in earnings per share for 1996, said it was confirming its objective of increasing its earnings per share and reducing its net debt-to-equity ratio below 0.5 in 1997.

Chairman Jean-Rene Fourtou said in a statement that the chemicals group had made progress in its strategy during 1996 through growth in life science businesses, restructuring in chemicals and fibres and 6.8 billion francs of divestments.
"In 1997, we will continue with this strategy and confirm our objectives of achieving improved performance in earnings per share and reducing the net debt to equity to less than 0.5."
